title: Texans lose promising second-year WR Jayden Higgins to season-ending injury

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Texans lose promising second-year WR Jayden Higgins to season-ending injury
sources.description: The Texans will be without one of C.J. Stroud's top young targets after Higgins reportedly tore his ACL and was ruled out for the season
